 <section id="6406026c90e1521f6ecb0ec9" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="6406026c90e1521f6ecb0ecb" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="6406026c90e1521f6ecb0ecc" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="6406026c90e1521f6ecb0ecd" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="layout-drawer-overlay" id="layout-drawer-overlay"></div> 
</div> 
 <div dmwrapped="true" id="dmFirstContainer" class="dmBody u_dmStyle_template_new-page09b1e3bb dm-home-page" themewaschanged="true"> <div id="allWrapper" class="allWrapper" data-auto="all-wrapper"><!-- navigation placeholders --> <div id="dm_content" class="dmContent" role="main"> <div dm:templateorder="170" class="dmHomeRespTmpl mainBorder dmRespRowsWrapper dmFullRowRespTmpl" id="1716942098"> <div data-flex-id="fe046669" data-auto="flex-section" id="1279587728" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1179030713"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1912121598"></div> 
 <section id="39b98792" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="d0f59b27" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="b84ecd62" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="d4259b57" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="5f530a93" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1505667564"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1505667564" data-ai-tag="Short title for section" style=""> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="display: unset;">About us</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="widget_83c" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1316235435"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1316235435" style=""><p class="size-16 t-size-16 m-size-16"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">Kevin first arrived in Tarifa back in 2006, pulling into town in a van with the simple plan of teaching a bit, kiting a lot, and probably moving on to the next windy spot once summer was over.<br/> But Tarifa has a way of getting under your skin &mdash; and twenty years later, he&rsquo;s still here, now one of the most experienced instructors in the area and the proud owner of High Flyers Kite House. That&rsquo;s the Tarifa effect.</span></p><p class="size-16 t-size-16 m-size-16"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">Kevin also lives in the Kite House, so he&rsquo;s always on hand with advice &mdash; whether it&rsquo;s choosing the right beach for the day&rsquo;s wind, recommending the best local restaurants, or suggesting unforgettable places to explore when you&rsquo;re not on the water. And for those visiting without any intention of kitesurfing, you&rsquo;re just as welcome; Tarifa has plenty to offer, whatever your interests.</span></p><p class="m-text-align-left text-align-left size-16 t-size-16 m-size-16"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">These days, Kevin still kites whenever he can, but he&rsquo;s equally passionate about exploring the wider region &mdash; from Andalucia&rsquo;s white villages, mountains and history to the flavours of Portugal and the colours and culture of Morocco. It&rsquo;s a wonderfully diverse corner of the world, and he loves sharing it with the people who stay at High Flyers.</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="fc94a968" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
 <div data-flex-id="fa5e915f" data-auto="flex-section" id="1959063918" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1517353472"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1110606567"></div> 
 <section id="cc2d380f" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="aca7f018" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="ebddc8f5" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="f547957f" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="0f47ca56" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1628070977"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1628070977" data-ai-tag="Short title for section" style=""> <h2 class="t-text-align-left m-text-align-left text-align-center"><span style="display: unset;">Why Tarifa?</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="4781b7ce" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1735429510"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1735429510" data-ai-tag="Paragraph" style=""><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">Tarifa is a truly magical place. The southern-most point of mainland Europe, with Morocco within touching distance. Where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Mediterranean Sea, and the starting point of one of Spain&acute;s most unspoilt coastlines: the Costa de la Luz. Most people fall in love with Tarifa. Many people find it impossible to leave (me being one!), and most come back time after time.</span> 
</span></p><p class="t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">If you want to do more than just kiteusrf / or kitesurfing isn't for you - Tarifa has you covered.</span> 
</span></p><p class="t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">What are you into? ​</span> 
</span></p><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">Surfing, Rock Climbing, Mountainbiking, Horse Riding, SCUBA Diving</span> 
</span></p><p class="t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">Whale Watching, Birdwatching, Hiking</span></p><p class="t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">Trips to Morocco, Cadiz, Jerez, Sevilla&nbsp;</span> 
</span></p><p class="t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-16 t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16 t-font-size-16 font-size-16" style="display: initial;">Great restaurants, Relaxing in cafes, Brilliant nightlife, Flamenco concerts</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="e271b93c" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
 <div data-flex-id="12c6887c" data-auto="flex-section" id="1616916721" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1307209320"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1272157019"></div> 
 <section id="785b4909" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="3b009059" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="81443b25" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="1b3d1822" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"></div> 
 <div id="f821179a" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="1e69de8a" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1866998237"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1866998237" data-ai-tag="Short title for section" style=""> <h2 class="t-text-align-left m-text-align-left text-align-center"><span style="display: unset;">Kitesurf with the Best!</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="e5e0e44f" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1020615997"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1020615997" data-ai-tag="Paragraph" style=""><p class="size-16 t-size-16 m-size-16"><span class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">Our trusted partners for kitesurf lessons in Tarifa are</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">KBC Tarifa</strong><span class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16" style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">&mdash; one of the most established and respected schools in the region. Their team will help you progress quickly, confidently and safely at our local spots.</span></span></p><p class="size-16 t-size-16 m-size-16"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">You&rsquo;ll be coached by professional IKO/VDWS-licensed instructors who speak English, Spanish and German, and who are experienced in adapting their teaching style to your level. Whether you&rsquo;re taking your very first lesson or fine-tuning your technique, you&rsquo;ll be guided step by step through the learning process with patience and expertise.</span></p><p class="t-size-16 m-text-align-left t-text-align-left size-16 m-size-16" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16" style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">For both lessons and equipment rental, you&rsquo;ll use the latest</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">F-ONE</strong><span class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16" style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;" class="font-size-16 t-font-size-16 m-font-size-16">gear in excellent condition &mdash; safe, modern, and perfectly suited to Tarifa&rsquo;s wind conditions.</span></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section>
